Let steps be taken for service of notice upon the respondent no.2 by registered post with A/D.

It is submitted that the marriage between the petitioner and the alleged victim has been registered and in this regard the learned counsel has drawn the attention of this Court to the Marriage Certificate issued by the Muslim Marriages & Divorces Registrar Kazi Buraburi, Mayong, Morigaon dated 15.02.2024.
